$description: Craft Your Money design tokens, in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. This file is an EXPORT of src/app/globals.css, not a second source: src/lib/tokens.test.ts fails if the two disagree. Values and roles come from docs/craft-your-money-design-system.md §1. Read by the live library at /design and by the Figma variables.

card.$description: The single framed surface only. Not for grouping.

ink.$description: All primary text and all numbers. Used at fixed opacities (see opacity.ink).

clay.$description: Identity accent: framing, top rules, the nav plus square.

clay-deep.$description: Actionable clay: links, buttons, active nav, verb-links, focus.

on-clay.$description: Text and icons on a clay-deep fill (primary button, the nav plus square, the send button). Warm off-white, not pure white, so it doesn't glare on clay.

iris.$description: The glint only. Appears only when the AI assistant is involved.

green.$description: Healthy. Chips only. Dark enough that chip text on its own 15% fill clears AA (4.5:1).

amber.$description: Caution. Chips only. Dark enough that chip text on its own 15% fill clears AA (4.5:1).

red.$description: Risky / loss. Chips only, plus the urgency stripe. Dark enough that chip text on its own 15% fill clears AA (4.5:1).

opacity.$description: Ink is never a set of greys: it is the one ink colour at fixed opacities. Tailwind writes these as text-ink/62, border-ink/14 and so on.

62.$description: Secondary labels, meta text, section labels (caps), inactive nav, unit suffixes. The lightest rung for text: 4.7:1 on page, so any size clears AA. Hierarchy below body copy comes from size, caps and tracking, not from a lighter ink.

30.$description: Placeholders, muted marks, the neutral stripe.

14.$description: Stronger dividers, input borders, dashed frames.

10.$description: The neutral chip's fill, and a disabled send button. A fill, never a line or text.

tint.$description: Tinted bands (briefing, insight strip): ink at 3.5%, deliberately lighter than any cream fill.

chip-fill.$description: A status chip's background: its status colour at 15%.

radius.$description: Nothing is rounder than 11px except chips. Generous radii read as app cards, the thing this system avoids.

button.$description: Buttons and the dropdown trigger. Also shadcn's --radius.

band.$description: Tinted bands, the framed surface, the edit shell, the assistant slot.

sheet.$description: Top corners of a bottom sheet (Drawer).

chip.$description: Chips only. This geometry means status.

space.$description: Spacing from §1.5. Layout-level steps sit on an 8pt rhythm and are named (Tailwind utilities pt-section, py-row, min-h-row-height…); inside a component the default 4pt scale is the grid, with 2px/1px allowed only as optical nudges. tap-target is 44px by WCAG, deliberately off the rhythm.

row.$description: Vertical padding of a single-line row: sheet items, attention rows. A product row is min-h row-height with tight padding instead, so it lands on exactly 64px.

section.$description: Between subsections within a zone; the top padding of a section.

serif.$description: Outputs and identity: product names, prices, all numbers, greetings, totals.

sans.$description: Everything else: labels, body, meta, buttons, navigation.

type.$description: The type scale from §1.4, one composite token per role. Every figure also sets font-feature-settings: tnum.

hero-figure.$description: Dashboard profit. Currency symbol at 29px, ink/42.

final-price.$description: Your price. Whole number; decimals at 25px, currency at 22px.

profit.$description: The profit figure. The one number allowed to carry its chip's tone.

title.$description: Greeting, page title, product name on the detail header.

figure.$description: A total (what this costs to make).

metric.$description: Supporting metric. Unit suffix 10.5px sans, ink/42.

row-name.$description: Product name in a list row.

row-value.$description: A money value on a list row.

section-total.$description: The total beside a section label, ink/55.

button-ghost.$description: Ghost button: medium, not semibold, so it sits back from the primary beside it.

assistant.$description: AssistantSlot label, iris-deep. The only text that wears the glint.

chip-sm.$description: Status chip inline in dense text (a dashboard attention row's meta line).

meta.$description: A row's meta line, ink/55. Not light weight, which read too thin.

meta-light.$description: Quiet meta and the reveal toggle.

section-label.$description: Section label (caps), ink/42. The system's quiet structural voice.

line.$description: Depth comes from lines, never from elevation. Colours are ink at an opacity, or the clay accent.

hairline.$description: Between subsections. No longer between rows in a list.

divider.$description: Before a summary, above a metric band, input borders.

accent-rule.$description: Historic top rule of the framed surface; today the price underline (2px).

urgency-stripe.$description: Inset, rounded, in the gutter of a list row. Status-coloured and urgency-scaled: red 100%, amber 55%, green 38%.

shadcn.$description: The shadcn/ui semantic tokens (:root in globals.css), mapped onto this palette so any shadcn primitive lands on-brand by default. Opacity tokens are baked to the nearest solid here because shadcn expects solids.

secondary.$description: A step below page. Not used by hand-skinned components.

muted-foreground.$description: ≈ ink at 62% on page, baked solid.

border.$description: ≈ ink at 14% on page, baked solid.
